\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 148-151 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:BN-R156-first-pass-words-from-chapters-148-151}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a birthday and late.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to cook, to sew, to iron, to sweep, to boil
  \item to swim, to slip, to rest, to hurry, to delay
  \item to doubt, to argue, to carry on, to sneeze, to cough
  \item to close, to build, to repair, to hang, to tie
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To cook? (\textbf{\bn{রান্না} \bn{করা}}, \emph{rānnā kôrā}.) To sew? (\textbf{\bn{সেলাই} \bn{করা}}, \emph{selāi kôrā}.) To iron? (\textbf{\bn{ইস্ত্রি} \bn{করা}}, \emph{istri kôrā}.) To sweep? (\textbf{\bn{ঝাঁট} \bn{দেওয়া}}, \emph{jhā̃ṭ deoyā}.) To boil? (\textbf{\bn{সেদ্ধ} \bn{করা}}, \emph{seddhô kôrā}.) To swim? (\textbf{\bn{সাঁতার} \bn{কাটা}}, \emph{sā̃tār kāṭā}.) To slip? (\textbf{\bn{পিছলে} \bn{পড়া}}, \emph{pichhle pôṛā}.) To rest? (\textbf{\bn{বিশ্রাম} \bn{নেওয়া}}, \emph{bishrām neoyā}.) To hurry? (\textbf{\bn{তাড়াতাড়ি} \bn{করা}}, \emph{tāṛātāṛi kôrā}.) To delay? (\textbf{\bn{দেরি} \bn{করা}}, \emph{deri kôrā}.) To doubt? (\textbf{\bn{সন্দেহ} \bn{করা}}, \emph{sôndeh kôrā}.) To argue? (\textbf{\bn{তর্ক} \bn{করা}}, \emph{tôrkô kôrā}.) To carry on? (\textbf{\bn{চালিয়ে} \bn{যাওয়া}}, \emph{chāliye jāoyā}.) To sneeze? (\textbf{\bn{হাঁচা}}, \emph{hā̃chā}.) To cough? (\textbf{\bn{কাশা}}, \emph{kāshā}.) To close? (\textbf{\bn{বন্ধ} \bn{করা}}, \emph{bôndhô kôrā}.) To build? (\textbf{\bn{গড়া}}, \emph{gôṛā}.) To repair? (\textbf{\bn{সারানো}}, \emph{sārāno}.) To hang? (\textbf{\bn{ঝোলানো}}, \emph{jholāno}.) To tie? (\textbf{\bn{বাঁধা}}, \emph{bā̃dhā}.)
\end{tcolorbox}

To bite? (\textbf{\bn{কামড়ানো}}, \emph{kāmṛāno}.) To discuss? (\textbf{\bn{আলোচনা} \bn{করা}}, \emph{ālochônā kôrā}.) To praise? (\textbf{\bn{প্রশংসা} \bn{করা}}, \emph{prôshôngsā kôrā}.) To scold? (\textbf{\bn{রোগ}}, \emph{rog}.) A cold? (\textbf{\bn{সর্দি}}, \emph{sôrdi}.) A cough? (\textbf{\bn{কাশি}}, \emph{kāshi}.) A headache? (\textbf{\bn{মাথাব্যথা}}, \emph{māthābæthā}.) A stomach ache? (\textbf{\bn{পেটব্যথা}}, \emph{peṭbæthā}.) A wrist? (\textbf{\bn{কবজি}}, \emph{kôbji}.) A lung? (\textbf{\bn{ফুসফুস}}, \emph{phusphus}.) A kidney? (\textbf{\bn{কিডনি}}, \emph{kiḍni}.) Exercise? (\textbf{\bn{ব্যায়াম}}, \emph{bæyām}.) Health? (\textbf{\bn{স্বাস্থ্য}}, \emph{svāsthyô}.) Sometimes? (\textbf{\bn{মাঝে} \bn{মাঝে}}, \emph{mājhe mājhe}.) At first? (\textbf{\bn{প্রথমে}}, \emph{prôthôme}.) A calendar date? (\textbf{\bn{তারিখ}}, \emph{tārikh}.) A birthday? (\textbf{\bn{জন্মদিন}}, \emph{jônmôdin}.) Late? (\textbf{\bn{দেরিতে}}, \emph{derite}.)
